items.summary: Approve containment-only execution. Reject new queue work, requeues, deployments, spending, telemetry expansion, dependency additions, monetization changes, external outreach, and unsupported financial or causal claims. Continue only existing repair-or-close, measurement, finance reconciliation, security evidence, private launch-gate, and parked-site readiness work. The only supported revenue evidence is aggregate provider commission that is not site-attributable; costs, margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, and causal lift remain unknown.

Complete one existing failed or stranded item, or document a justified close, before queue admission reopens. Record dated ownership, root cause or rationale, isolated validation, rollback, release and security boundaries, attribution and measurement limits, and deduplication evidence. Do not retry unchanged failures.

Continue only the existing period-aligned reconciliation. Preserve aggregate provider earnings as unattributed and keep matching-period costs, budgets, margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, and cost-to-learn unknown. Do not extrapolate one-day revenue or non-matching AI costs.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Preserve private and parked launch gates; block public exposure and security-sensitive releases. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue unchanged work, or conduct outreach.

Keep scaffold properties parked, private, and preview-only. Continue existing dated readiness packets covering ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance, security, measurement boundaries, rollback, and explicit blockers. Do not build, publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or create queue entries.

Validate already-deployed changes using available telemetry only. Preserve unavailable values as unknown and do not claim causal lift, revenue, conversion impact, or attribution beyond recorded evidence. Do not duplicate work, add tracking, or requeue items during containment.
